_comment: Site-wide expectations for verify.py. Independent of site.json on purpose: verify.py cross-checks site.json against these values instead of trusting it.
name: Filings Trail
author: Ronan Schultz
_repo_comment: H fails unless site.json repo_url equals repo_url here. C1 exempts the owner handle inside href="<repo_url>..." attribute values only (the GitHub account name, not a byline); the same words in visible text, other attributes, PDF text or any other URL still count as stray name words.
